## Objective
- Build a complete, playable football game in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a browser-based arcade football match, “Final Whistle,” with a 90-second clock, first-to-five scoring, keyboard controls, and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added the game UI, pitch rendering, player movement, ball possession, shooting, AI opponents, scoring, match-end screen, and responsive styling in `index.html`.
- Verified the embedded JavaScript parses with `node --check`.
- Opened `http://localhost:3002` in Playwright; page title is “Final Whistle — Football.”

### Active
- Browser check is incomplete; no screenshot has been saved or inspected.
- Game interactions and console should be checked.

### Blocked
- Playwright showed one console error: favicon request returned 404 (`http://localhost:3002/favicon.ico`); gameplay was not yet tested.

## Next Move
1. Save a small JPEG screenshot and inspect the latest image.
2. Test kickoff, movement, shooting, and match behavior in the browser; check console output.
3. Address the favicon 404 if appropriate and fix any gameplay issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; currently the only modified project file.

## Important Context
- A Python HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable football game in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built “Final Whistle,” a browser-based arcade football match with a 90-second clock, first-to-five scoring, keyboard controls, and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game UI, pitch rendering, player movement, ball possession, shooting, AI opponents, scoring, match-end screen, and responsive styling in `index.html`.
- Verified the embedded JavaScript parses with `node --check`.
- Opened `http://localhost:3002`; page title is “Final Whistle — Football.”
- Started a match via `#playBtn` and saved/inspected a live-match screenshot.

### Active
- Fix or remove the favicon 404 and recheck browser console.
- Test movement, shooting, scoring, and match completion in the browser.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add a favicon or suppress the missing favicon request, then reload and check console.
2. Exercise movement and shooting; verify scoring and match-end behavior.
3. Save and inspect a new latest JPEG screenshot after any changes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; currently uncommitted.

## Important Context
- A Python HTTP server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The browser currently reports one console error: favicon request returned 404 (`http://localhost:3002/favicon.ico`).
- Screenshot paths: `/tmp/opencode/final-whistle.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/final-whistle-live.jpg`; the live screenshot was the latest inspected image.
